summary: Full frontend retest of the rewritten Campus Map (underwater panorama) across desktop (1280x800) and phone (390x844) viewports, both unlocked and locked states. All acceptance criteria pass: panorama scroller present with scrollWidth > clientWidth, shelf width = 2300px desktop / 1740px phone, 7 buildings on PLAY street with sight-reading/robot-boogie initially off-screen (left=1620,1920 > 1280), scrolling to scrollLeft=1200 brings robot-boogie into view (left=720), swipe hint visible before scroll and gone after. Life elements verified: campus-you present, blimp-flyby present, fish svgs (47), each open building has host img + music note svgs, shout bubbles ('Hey!','Woo!',etc.) appear within ~7s. Navigation works: stew-kazoo -> /#/simon-says with door transition; beat-lab on create -> /#/loop-studio; learn zone shows 5 buildings including boom-garden. Phone shelf width 1740px, buildings <=170px wide, all tops >=120 (sit low), no overlap between Back button and street chip. Locked state (jma_unlock_all_v1='0', stickers removed, hard reload): starters (jelly-jukebox, stew-kazoo, detective-jellybone) open with hosts and 3 music svgs; non-starters (shred-legend, note-match, sight-reading, robot-boogie) have data-locked='true', lock chip visible, 1 img (building art only, no host), 0 music svgs; click on shred-legend did not navigate. No pageerrors across streets/viewports; only expected noise (Vimeo 401, warnings about duplicate keys from existing components, Turnstile re-render warning).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: existing console warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' is not from CampusMapPage but should be chased in sibling components (unchanged this iteration).
Street-name chip has no data-testid; adding data-testid='campus-street-chip' would make future automated overlap checks easier (currently verified visually).
seed_data_creation: localStorage: jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1', jma_reveal_seen_v1='1', jma_unlock_all_v1 toggled 1<->0, jma_stickers_v1 removed for locked test; sessionStorage: jma_audio_unlocked_v1='1'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Campus v3 (underwater panorama) is fully verified. All acceptance criteria from the review request pass across desktop and phone, unlocked and locked states. Locked state only reflects correctly after a hard reload (localStorage mutation + page.reload) since useUnlocks reads at mount via useState initializer. Other features (quests, voice, avatar, encore) were not retested per request.
